method CountOddLowerCaseLetters(txt: string) returns (count: int)

    ensures count == |{c: char | c in txt && 'a' <= c && c <= 'z' && (ord(c) % 2) == 1}|

def check(candidate):

    assert candidate("Hello world!") == ["Hello","world!"]
    assert candidate("Hello,world!") == ["Hello","world!"]
    assert candidate("Hello world,!") == ["Hello","world,!"]
    assert candidate("Hello,Hello,world !") == ["Hello,Hello,world","!"]
